answers.reason: The senate decides on university-wide matters and the research associate does not hold a central leadership office specified for it.
The budget planning round involves higher rank office holders and central administration, not research associates.
Appointment committees select candidates for professorships, in which research associates do not have a formal participation right.
Faculty councils are led by deans and include specific representatives, excluding research associates by default.
Study commissions advise on teaching, but research associates are not mentioned as members.
Examination boards decide on student examination matters without the participation of research associates.
Internal research funding rounds award grants for research projects, but research associates only assist in research rather than allocate funds.
Module revision working groups rewrite descriptions, but this is not part of the research associate's defined duties.
Laboratory equipment procurement is outside the role description of a research associate.
Orientation week planning is not among the duties assigned to research associates.
